blocks.html: Swagier Sand Scoops: The Heavy-Duty Choice for Beach Detecting
Built for the Beach. Engineered to Last.

Stop replacing cheap sand scoops. Swagier sand scoops are crafted from marine-grade stainless steel to handle the toughest wet sand, clay, and rocky shorelines. Whether you are hunting for rings in the surf or coins in the dry sand, Swagier offers the professional reliability you need at a price you can afford.
Swagier Scoops built to last
1. Marine-Grade Durability
Every scoop is welded from AISI 304 Stainless Steel. This offers exceptional resistance to salt corrosion, ensuring your gear survives season after season in harsh ocean environments.
2. Hex-Hole Technology

Swagier uses a signature hexagonal hole pattern (honeycomb design). This structural choice allows water and sand to flow out faster than traditional round holes while maintaining superior strength and preventing mesh deformation.
3. Electropolished Finish

Swagier don't just paint their scoops; they treat them. The electropolishing process smoothes the steel surface on a microscopic level, creating a chrome-like shine that sheds sand easily and Stainless steel wont rust.
Meet the Line up
The "Tank": Swagier V5
Best For: Deep water wading, wet heavy sand, and rocky bottoms.
The Lowdown: Our Favourite heavy-duty model. With a large basket volume and thick steel plate, the V5 is designed to recover deep targets in one scoop before the hole fills in.
Specs: AISI 304, 2mm Stainless steel.
7mm and 10mm hex holes.
29mm shaft size.
Dimensions 290mm x 180mm x 119mm
Weight 1700gr
The "Sniper": Swagier V2 (Sito)
Best For: Dry Sand, Coins, Micro-jewellery, stud earrings, and fine chains.
The Lowdown: Don’t lose the small gold. The V2 features a hybrid mesh of 7mm and 10mm holes. It captures tiny finds that slip through standard scoops while still clearing sand quickly.

Which sand scoop is right for me?
I hunt mostly in the water: Go for the V2. The weight helps dig into the bottom, and the volume helps you trap the target quickly.
I have shoulder issues / I am older: Go for the V8. It is significantly lighter and easier to swing for 3+ hours.
I hunt in Europe/areas with tiny coins: Go for the V12. The smaller holes are essential for jewellery.
Buyer’s Guide: What You Need to Know

Note on Handles: Swagier scoops are sold as Head Only. To complete your setup, you will need a handle (shaft). We recommend a Carbon Fiber or Ash Wood handle with a diameter of 28-29mm for the best balance of weight and strength.
